problem: Product catalogs can accumulate vendor names that differ only by case, spacing, punctuation, or near-identical spelling, which can fragment filtering and internal catalog organization.
target_merchant: Stores with imported or long-running catalogs that rely on vendor names for filtering, reporting, and merchandising.
first_release: Detect vendor names that collapse to the same normalized form by case, whitespace, and punctuation.
Group affected products under each suspicious vendor-name cluster.
Prioritize high-frequency naming drift without changing product data.
Export a read-only remediation CSV with direct product links.
constraints: Do not claim two vendor names are definitively the same business.

evidence: Shopify Community support notes that duplicate-looking vendor entries can be caused by case differences such as lowercase versus uppercase vendor names.
Current App Store results include a read-only vendor checker focused on missing/default/placeholder vendors, leaving a narrower naming-consistency workflow distinct.
